pages.text: numpy.vdot — NumPy v2.6.dev0 Manual Skip to main content Back to top Ctrl + K System Settings Light Dark Choose version GitHub Collapse Sidebar Expand Sidebar numpy.vdot # numpy. vdot ( a , b , / ) # Return the dot product of two vectors. The vdot function handles complex numbers differently than dot : if the first argument is complex, it is replaced by its complex conjugate in the dot product calculation. vdot also handles multidimensional arrays differently than dot : it does not perform a matrix product, but flattens the arguments to 1-D arrays before taking a vector dot product. Consequently, when the arguments are 2-D arrays of the same shape, this function effectively returns their Frobenius inner product (also known as the trace inner product or the standard inner product on a vector space of matrices). Parameters : a array_like If a is complex the complex conjugate is taken before calculation of the dot product. b array_like Second argument to the dot product. Returns : output ndarray Dot product of a and b . Can be an int, float, or complex depending on the types of a and b . See also dot Return the dot product without using the complex conjugate of the first argument. Examples Try it in your browser! >>> import numpy as np >>> a = np . array ([ 1 + 2 j , 3 + 4 j ]) >>> b = np . array ([ 5 + 6 j , 7 + 8 j ]) >>> np . vdot ( a , b ) (70-8j) >>> np . vdot ( b , a ) (70+8j) Note that higher-dimensional arrays are flattened! >>> a = np . array ([[ 1 , 4 ], [ 5 , 6 ]]) >>> b = np . array ([[ 4 , 1 ], [ 2 , 2 ]]) >>> np . vdot ( a , b ) 30 >>> np . vdot ( b , a ) 30 >>>

NumPy ( Num erical Py thon) is an open source Python library that’s widely used in science and engineering. The NumPy library contains multidimensional array data structures, such as the homogeneous, N-dimensional ndarray , and a large library of functions that operate efficiently on these data structures. Learn more about NumPy at What is NumPy , and if you have comments or suggestions, please reach out ! How to import NumPy # After installing NumPy , it may be imported into Python code like: import numpy as np This widespread convention allows access to NumPy features with a short, recognizable prefix ( np. ) while distinguishing NumPy features from others that have the same name. [ 4 , 5 , 6 ]]) >>> a . shape (2, 3) Text preceded by >>> or ... is input , the code that you would enter in a script or at a Python prompt. On Thursday, Huang stepped down from the US chip giant after admitting he had an affair. He was reportedly involved with a woman named Alice Huang, who ran Singaporean data centre company Megaspeed, a major buyer of Nvidia's chips. For decades, Singapore has painstakingly cultivated a reputation as an open, business-friendly economy offering easy access to both the US and Chinese markets. With the AI boom, it has become a major hub for the trade of high-end semiconductor chips in recent years. Singapore was the second-largest billing centre globally last year for Nvidia, accounting for nearly a fifth of what the US chip giant earns. It describes occupations in terms of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required as well as how the work is performed in terms of tasks, work activities, and other descriptors. O*NET database Content Model Every occupation requires a different mix of knowledge, skills, and abilities, and is performed using a variety of activities and tasks. These distinguishing characteristics, or "descriptors", of an occupation are collected, codified, and described by the O*NET Content Model . This hierarchical model starts with six domains (or categories), describing the day-to-day aspects of the job and the qualifications and interests of the typical worker. The model includes nearly 277 descriptors collected by the O*NET program, along with other occupational data collected by other federal agencies such as the Bureau of Labor Statistics . Data Collection Real-world information The Data Collection program brings the Content Model frameworks to life with results from the working public. The O*NET database is collected and updated through ongoing surveys of workers in each occupation supplemented in some cases by occupation experts. Zanthoxylum oahuense Oahu Pricklyash View Profile FWS Focus overview characteristics geography timeline information & media contact Overview Zanthoxylum oahuense, a member of the rue family (Rutaceae), is a small tree, 3 to 6 m (10 to 20 ft) tall, with gray to dark brown bark that is thin and smooth to slightly furrowed. New growth is finely hairy, becoming glabrate (without hairs). Young branches are subtended by a pair of bud scales. Leaflets are in sets of three, leathery, triangular, with the lateral pair usually asymmetrical, 7 to 16 cm (2.8 to 6 in) long, 4.5 to 9 cm (1.8 to 3.5 in) wide. Leaf veins form a reticulate pattern. Leaf margins are shallow-toothed to smooth, usually sickle-shaped, with the base flat or notched. Leaf stalks are twice jointed and 35 to 72 mm (1.4 to 2.8 in) long. Plants are dioecious (male and female flowers on separate plants), rarely monoecious. Unisexual flowers are in groups of 15 to 40 arising between the leaf base and stem, and the terminal flowers bloom first. The inflorescences are usually 8 to 12 cm (3 to 4.7 in) long and finely hairy throughout. Petals are pale greenish yellow, sometimes tinged with red, 4 to 7 mm (0.15 to 0.3 in) long and glabrous. OCED's Guide to NEPA What is NEPA? The National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) was signed into law by President Nixon on January 1, 1970, setting forth, for the first time, a national policy on the protection of the environment. The purpose of NEPA is to ensure that the federal government understands and considers the potential impact of the human environment when planning and making decisions on how to use federal resources on new projects. Video Url Ensuring that federal investments are planned and executed in a responsible, equitable, and environmentally sound manner is critically important to the U.S. Department of Energy. That’s why all projects funded by DOE’s Office of Clean Energy Demonstrations must comply with the National Environmental Policy Act — or NEPA. What do OCED awardees need to know about NEPA? There are three main types of NEPA review requiring different levels of documentation and analysis: categorical exclusion, environmental assessment, and environmental impact statement. U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development developed community resources for NLPPW. pages.text: ODEP News Brief | U.S. Department of Labor Skip to main content ODEP News Brief October 2026 Join the Secretary of Labor for a Virtual NDEAM Celebration It’s National Disability Employment Awareness Month! This October, as ODEP turns 25, we’re celebrating a landmark moment in a landmark year: Today, employment and workforce participation rates of disabled working-age Americans have reached all-time record highs. Together with Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling, ODEP Assistant Secretary Julie Hocker, and other department leaders, we’re marking this historic achievement and celebrating NDEAM in a wide-ranging virtual event. Stream the video now and find out how the Department of Labor is helping more American businesses find skilled workers and succeed. Watch the NDEAM webcast Coming Soon: ODEP’s Career Track Challenge! ODEP is launching the Career Track Challenge, a national prize competition to create accessible digital tools that connect disabled American job seekers to high-skill, high-paying jobs. We’re calling on innovators, developers, entrepreneurs, workforce experts, and our entire disability community to design cutting-edge concepts for digital tools that will empower job seekers with disabilities to translate their strengths and goals into real-world careers in local, high-demand industries. The competition will begin in January 2027 and we’re offering an informational webinar on Dec. 3 for everyone interested in participating. "Here you will be in the kitchen, and here is the bathroom," says the deputy CEO of French real estate company Groupama Immobilier. It all sounds appealing, an upmarket flat in the west of Paris, but presently the space doesn't look like one at all. That's because it's currently a corner of one floor of a nine-storey office building called Le Diamant, where 1,800 people work. Groupama Immobilier intends to convert the entire building into apartments. It should be the first of many such office-to-apartments conversions in the surrounding area. We are in La Défense, the purpose-built, business district of the French capital, where the city has congregated its modern skyscrapers. Mirroring a similar trend in places such as New York, Washington DC and London; Paris La Défense, the public development authority that runs the area, has unveiled plans to turn up to a fifth of the office buildings into housing. In this session, program directors will briefly discuss technical details about submitting a proposal for the ExLENT funding opportunity and answer questions about the program. Register on Zoom Real-time captions will be available. For other reasonable accommodations, please email rarequest@nsf.gov in advance. About the ExLENT Program Through this new initiative, the Directorate for STEM Education (EDU) and the Directorate for Technology, Innovation and Partnerships (TIP) seek to support experiential learning opportunities for individuals from diverse professional and educational backgrounds that will increase access to, and interest in, career pathways in emerging technology fields (e.g., advanced manufacturing, advanced wireless, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, quantum information science, semiconductors, and microelectronics). ExLENT proposals are due September 14, 2023. For more information, visit the Experiential Learning for Emerging and Novel Technologies (ExLENT) webpage .
